name: δ_naturality
statement: M} {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [F.OplaxMonoidal] : (δ F m n).app X ≫ (F.obj n).map ((F.obj m).map f) = (F.obj _).map f ≫ (δ F m n).app Y

name: associativity_app
statement: M) (X : C) [F.LaxMonoidal] : (F.obj m₃).map ((μ F m₁ m₂).app X) ≫ (μ F (m₁ ⊗ m₂) m₃).app X ≫ (F.map (α_ m₁ m₂ m₃).hom).app X = (μ F m₂ m₃).app ((F.obj m₁).obj X) ≫ (μ F m₁ (m₂ ⊗ m₃)).app X

have_tree.body: congr_app (associativity F m₁ m₂ m₃) X
